cands.bio: Democrat and attorney who owns Patrice E. McClammy, Attorney-At-Law, LLC. She has held Alabama House District 76 since November 17, 2021, after the death of Thad McClammy created a vacancy. She holds a J.D. from Faulkner University and a Ph.D. in public policy and administration from Florida State University.

endorsements.text: Listed as a recommended candidate in the voter guide "Tabitha's List: Candidates You Can Trust" (Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner).

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was born or raised, or when she moved to Alabama. We found no stated positions from her on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth and development, immigration, policing, guns, abortion, or schools. We also found no documented actions on those topics, such as sponsored bills. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022 or 2026. The sponsored-legislation list on the page we read was empty, so we could not identify specific bills. We found no controversies, foreign ties, or land-use stances in the page we read.

qual.background: Alabama House member since November 2021, serving on the Judiciary and Financial Services committees. She is an attorney who owns her own law practice, with a J.D. (2002) and a Ph.D. in public policy and administration (2006).
qual.why: She has about four years of prior legislative service plus a law career and doctoral-level policy training, which fits the high range for writing law and the state budget. Committee seats were not counted.
